none: PAS CAM-D7FF45: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. Mint is Aquileia, AD364-367, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding standard. See LRBC, p.67, c.f.992-993. Obverse shows pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: - crescent//[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight…
